605:t_107:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$シュロウガ$$... The time has come for our black wings to transcend causality.」

605:t_107:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Now, clad in hellfire, the fate that stood still will tear through the Heavenly Prison!!」

605:t_108:0.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
(I swear to $$アンナロッタ$$, $$ジェミニス$$... to every life on planet $$ジェミナイ$$... and to the new lives that have been born!)

605:t_108:1.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
(I have taken up your regrets and your wishes for the future!)

605:t_108:2.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「I am $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$! I am a warrior of the $$ジェミナイド$$s!」

605:t_109:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I've returned to this seat once again...」

605:t_109:1.en:
$n
「Your new suit and glasses... They look good on you.」

605:t_109:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Thank you, $n. Your smile is starting to look natural too.」

605:t_109:5.en:
$n
「I know! Now that you and I are together, Miss $$スズネ$$, I'll bring out all of $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$'s power!」

605:t_109:6.en:
$n
「This is the strength we fight with!」

605:t_110:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Humanity is moving toward the future...」

605:t_110:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Whoever stands in its way, we will overcome them...!」

605:t_111:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「The future $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$ envisioned... $$イノベイター$$s...」

605:t_111:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「If that's what I am, I'll open the way! To the future humanity should advance into!」

605:t_112:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ユニコーン$$... Your role as the key to $$ラプラスの箱$$ ends today...」

605:t_112:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But our battle isn't over yet...!」

605:t_112:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's go, $$ユニコーン$$! We'll defeat those who close off possibility and make it back to $$オードリー$$!」
